summary: All Python files must compile on every supported Python version: control node code on 3.12 to 3.14, and target code (modules and module_utils) on 3.9 to 3.14, depending on ansible-core version.
questions: Which Python versions must my module support?
What Python versions does controller code need to support?
What does the compile sanity test check?

answer_card.title: compile test and supported Python
answer_card.answer_md:
All Python files must compile on all supported versions (these depend on your ansible-core version):
- **Control node** code, including collection plugins: 3.14, 3.13, 3.12
- **Target** code (`modules`, `module_utils`): 3.14 down to 3.9

Collections can be configured to support a subset of the target-only versions.
